display.purpose: Hero headline only, poster-scale, allowed to overflow the viewport at the low end of its clamp.

accent.purpose: One italic serif word inside a display composition — a hand-annotation, not a body face.

body.purpose: Reading copy, capped at a 62ch measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, metric labels, nav links.

mono.purpose: The playground's print-label captions only — nowhere else.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition and reveal in the system.

components.name: Pill CTA Button
components.description: The system's only button shape — border-only pill, used for every CTA (case lede, archive rows, gate submits).
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { display: inline-block; font-family: 'General Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--fg); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--fg-dim); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.65rem 1.15rem; transition: background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: var(--screen); border-color: var(--fg-dim); } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Password Input (gate field)
components.description: Pill-shaped text input paired with the peek/show-password toggle, used by CaseGate and LockedGate.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; font-family: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1875rem; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--fg-dim); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-peek { flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; color: var(--fg-dim); background: none; border: 1px solid var(--fg-dim); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: A case-study tile for the drag rail or /work index — square media frame, scale-on-hover image, scope label above title, metric below.
components.html:
IAM · Enterprise

Rebuilding IAM for enterprise admins

Admin task time down [X]%
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card__media { aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0; background: var(--rule); } .ds-card__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: scale 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card__media img { scale: 1.03; } .ds-card__meta { padding-top: 1rem; display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-card__scope { margin: 0; font-family: 'General Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-dim); } .ds-card__title { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card__metric { margin: 0; color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 0.9rem; }

components.name: Fixed Nav
components.description: Solid (never translucent) fixed top nav that recolours to match whichever themed band is behind it.
components.html:

WorkAbout mePlayground
components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; inset-inline: 0; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1.5rem 4vw; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg); transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav__mark { font-family: 'General Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav__right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav__right a { font-family: 'General Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Uppercase Label / Eyebrow
components.description: The system's one recurring micro-typography role: uppercase, tracked-out General Sans in the dim foreground colour — eyebrows, metric labels, nav links.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'General Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg-dim); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a designer's own printed broadside, not a SaaS marketing page: hard-edged type blocks blown up to poster scale, saturated flat-colour grounds standing in for pages of a booklet, and a serif italic used the way a hand-annotation would be. Nothing here is soft — no shadows, no blur, no rounded cards — except the one control the visitor actually touches, the pill-shaped CTA, which is deliberately the single curved thing on the page.

Density is editorial, not app-like: generous section rhythm (up to 11rem), a 62ch reading measure for body copy, and display type sized in vw so headlines are allowed to overflow toward the viewport edge the way a poster's type would. The palette is not a light/dark pair but a sequence of eight named grounds, each a full 'page' of the broadside with its own day and night restatement — the visitor moves through the site the way they'd turn pages in a printed piece, and the fixed nav recolours itself to always match the page currently behind it.
keyCharacteristics: Hard-edged, flat-colour grounds — one full palette per section, not a single site-wide theme
Poster-scale display type (clamp(3.5rem, 13vw, 15rem)) with tight, near-negative tracking
A single curved element (the pill CTA) against an otherwise 0-radius system
Editorial serif italic (Instrument Serif) as the one ornamental typographic gesture
Every palette exists twice — a day and a night restatement — never a single fixed light/dark pair

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Never simplify sand's display and body green into a single value; the display tone alone fails body-text contrast on that ground.

rules.name: The Bone Banner Rule
rules.body: Every case-study banner is bone, never the project's own palette — a full-bleed saturated ground behind display type reads as a poster and fights the reading page beneath it.

rules.name: The Radius Exception Rule
rules.body: --radius is 0px site-wide; the pill CTA (border-radius: 999px) is the one deliberate exception, and it stays a border-only control, never a filled ground, so it reads as a control rather than a badge.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears inside display type only — one italic word per composition, functioning like a hand annotation, never a body-copy typeface.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow exists anywhere in the token system or components; depth is conveyed entirely through flat colour-ground changes between sections.

rules.name: The Clip Not Hidden Rule
rules.body: Any future horizontal-overflow fix on <body> must use overflow-x: clip, not hidden — hidden forces overflow-y: auto and silently breaks position: sticky on the page (the case-study rail specifically).

dos: Do keep every colour, size, and spacing value as a var(--token) reference.
Do give every new palette a [data-mode='night'] restatement in the same pass it's added.
Do use the border-pill shape for any new interactive control that needs to read as a 'button.'
Do route case-study banners through bone regardless of the case's own palette.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on any new motion.
donts: Don't introduce a shadow, blur, or glass surface anywhere.
Don't collapse sand's or iris's two-tone (display/body) colour pairs into one value.
Don't hardcode a hex, px, or ms value in a component — add a token to tokens.css first.
Don't treat the CaseGate/LockedGate password panels as real security in copy or implementation.
